notes.title: Fitz the Fox Winter Update
notes.notes:
Hey guys Fitz the Fox just got a little update with a really cool feature that I think we've needed for a while. In this update we've added checkpoints! So now the game feels a bit more fair. 

We've also added a few fixes with the color mode and have set the groundwork for some more cool things in the future.

Enjoy and thanks for play :)

notes.title: Minor Bug fix and Soundtrack!!!!1!
notes.notes: We are slowly adding content and fixing the bugs that you guys are pointing out to us. (Thanks for all of the feedback by the way) One of the issues was that clouds were not giving out points like they were supposed to. Also, we have included the soundtrack by popular demand. Hope you guys enjoy, there are some more big things happening in the very near future. He have some major plans that we hope to reveal soon!

notes.title: Update
notes.notes: Just some more minor fixes. I noticed some people didn't know there were two sets of last levels so I added a "Pick a Fox" text to help show that option more. You'll see it in the last cutscene before finishing the game.

notes.title: small update
notes.notes:
really small...
Some of you guys were having problems with the unlockable colormode. It should be fixed now but let me know if you still have problems. 

If you managed to turn color mode on you'll have it unlocked for you automaticly and you can find the setting in your options.

notes.title: Fitz the Fox release!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I am Evan Spiker head producer of Bread Vision Studios.  I just wanted to say how excited we are for Fitz to finally hit Steam and to thank everyone that gave Fitz the upvote in greenlight. As you know we wouldn't be here now if not for you guys. <3

Now for the people who bough the game through the Indie Royal bundle with the promise of the steam key we are attempting to get in contact with desura about this but from what we know they will still be able to provide everyone with thier keys. If not we will work to get everyone their rightful steam key. I will post updates on both our site and here check back to keep up to date with all of this.

Thanks again for all your support and we really hope you like Fitz the Fox! :D
